name: Dill

schedule.notes: Doesn't transplant — taproot. Succession every 3 weeks for leafy dill.
Cut leafy tops anytime. Heads for pickling at full bloom.

harvest.cues: Leaves: anytime. Flower heads: when buds fully opened. Seeds: heads turn brown.
harvest.storageNotes: Fresh fronds wilt fast — freeze chopped in water cubes. Seeds keep a year in a sealed jar.

varieties.name: Fernleaf
varieties.notes: Dwarf 18 in tall, slow to bolt. Best for containers.

varieties.name: Bouquet
varieties.notes: Tall 3 ft. Big heads for pickling. Self-seeds prolifically.

notes: Lets some flower and set seed; volunteers return year after year. Hosts swallowtail butterfly larvae — never the same plant for both dill leaves AND butterflies, but plant extras for them.
